known_outcome: Regulator position: a storage container is either an acceptable solution under Division B or an alternative solution under Division A. Because containers do not meet prescriptive NBC(AE) requirements, the AHJ may request an engineering review and certified plans; storage of dangerous goods must be disclosed to the AHJ; items stored in the container are considered when setting spacing.
review_focus: Separates the Division B acceptable-solution route from the Division A alternative-solution route
Flags the engineering-review and certified-plans request as an AHJ option, not a fixed requirement
Notes dangerous-goods disclosure and stored-content spacing as open questions for the file
Does not state that a container arrangement complies or is safe
alberta_evaluation_use: source extraction and administrative evidence exercise; not technical approval
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
